name: E. A. Stedman
bio: E. A. Stedman was the Wells-Fargo express route agent who visited Medora regularly from November 1885 to April 1886. In December 1885 he joined Medora citizens in protesting a proposed change in agent Maxwell's position.

moments.label: Protested the change in agent Maxwell's position

mentions: Route agent Stedman of the Wells-Fargo express Co., was here this week, looking after the interests of the company he so ably represents.
